coordinateSystem.name: W
coordinateSystem.origin: Centre of the candidate base mounting pattern on the finished cell floor.

axes.y: positive toward finished-tray and inspection side

coordinateSystem.orientationConvention: Right-handed. Pose rotations are XYZ intrinsic degrees unless a neutral motion manifest declares an equivalent unambiguous convention.

anchorPattern.fasteners: 8 × M16 property class 10.9 anchors supplied by cell integrator; candidate shall design the mating base and state preload and foundation assumptions.

floorMounting.floorAssumption: Reinforced concrete foundation. Candidate shall not assume an infinite-rigid foundation; it shall declare the base/foundation stiffness and anchoring model used for accuracy and safety claims.

toolInterface.definition: TCP is a candidate-declared datum rigidly related to the gripper. Its transform and payload state shall be present in every motion-manifest pose.
toolInterface.endEffectorInterface: Candidate-designed. The candidate shall provide a controlled interface drawing between wrist and gripper and shall not rely on an undeclared purchased end-effector.

machineInterfaces.name: CNC load fixture
machineInterfaces.leadIn: The cell provides a 20 degree × 3 mm chamfer at the fixture mouth. Candidate shall provide the remaining alignment strategy.

machineInterfaces.name: Inspection nest
machineInterfaces.leadIn: Four 4 mm radius guide features are available; no clamp is provided by the cell.

utilityInterfaces.electrical: Common controller provides 400 VAC three-phase and 24 VDC at the base service point. Candidate shall declare required channels, power estimate, and moving-cable strategy; cable selection is intentionally candidate-designed.
utilityInterfaces.pneumatic: 0.55 MPa filtered compressed air is available at the base service point. Pneumatic actuation is permitted but the candidate shall state loss-of-air behavior and all valves/springs needed for the mechanical safety concept.
utilityInterfaces.routingConstraint: All moving utilities must remain inside the service envelope or a candidate-declared protected route. They must not cross machine openings or required operator access zones.

provenance.sourceClass: benchmark-design-basis; ISO 9409-1:2004 informs the mechanical-interface convention but does not prescribe this cell's anchor pattern.
provenance.basis: Benchmark-author industrial-cell synthesis fixed for v1.0.
provenance.applicability: Candidate floor, fixture, TCP, utility, clearance, and approach calculations.
provenance.uncertainty: Unless a tighter tolerance is stated, public envelope coordinates have ±2 mm authoring tolerance and are not claimed to be metrology-grade as-built data.
